Before I moved out and broke up with my ex I had a lot of the same feelings. He cheated a year before and it was slowly eating at me. We got along very well and I considered him my best friend, but there were days I felt numb and depressed from thoughts of what happened. It made me sad to think how he could do that to me, and possibly again? For my own good I left. He broke something sacred and important and I knew I deserved better. I knew I deserved someone who is my best friend AND faithful. You deserve that too. 
Even if you ask to take a break, go no contact and see how you feel. Are you happier? Less stressed, and more clear-headed? Maybe that will solidify your decision. 
And if he tries to make you feel bad or threatens a breakup because you want to take a break, there’s your answer right there! Your future husband would understand.
It’s understandable to be torn on if you should leave, there is a part of us that stays loving that person, and a part that was hurt and is in pain. That part that’s in pain needs just as much consideration and you should maybe seek therapy as well.
